-- Fenêtre fixe sur l'heure complète précédente (ex : si 14h05 → [13h00, 14h00[)
-- Évite la dérive temporelle du bug NOW()-1h
SELECT
  sensor_id,
  location_id,
  sensor_name,
  city,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  pollutant,
  value,
  unit,
  datetime_utc
FROM silver_iot_clean
WHERE datetime_utc >= DATE_TRUNC('hour', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  AND datetime_utc <  DATE_TRUNC('hour', NOW());

INSERT INTO gold_pollution_hourly
  (sensor_id, pollutant, hour_utc, city, latitude, longitude,
   avg_value, max_value, min_value, samples_count, computed_at)
VALUES
  ('{{$json["sensor_id"]}}',
   '{{$json["pollutant"]}}',
   '{{$json["hour_utc"]}}',
   {{$json["city"] ? "'" + $json["city"].replace(/'/g,"''") + "'" : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["latitude"]  !== null ? $json["latitude"]  : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["longitude"] !== null ? $json["longitude"] : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["avg_value"]}},
   {{$json["max_value"]}},
   {{$json["min_value"]}},
   {{$json["samples_count"]}},
   NOW())
ON CONFLICT (sensor_id, pollutant, hour_utc)
DO UPDATE SET
  avg_value     = EXCLUDED.avg_value,
  max_value     = EXCLUDED.max_value,
  min_value     = EXCLUDED.min_value,
  samples_count = EXCLUDED.samples_count,
  computed_at   = NOW();

-- Agrégat journalier par ville et polluant (granularité jour)
INSERT INTO gold_pollution_daily_city
  (city, pollutant, day_utc, avg_value, max_value, min_value, samples_count, sensors_count, computed_at)
SELECT
  city,
  pollutant,
  DATE_TRUNC('day', hour_utc)::DATE AS day_utc,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_value,
  MAX(max_value)                    AS max_value,
  MIN(min_value)                    AS min_value,
  SUM(samples_count)                AS samples_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sensor_id)         AS sensors_count,
  NOW()                             AS computed_at
FROM gold_pollution_hourly
WHERE city IS NOT NULL
  AND hour_utc >= DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND hour_utc <  DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW())
GROUP BY city, pollutant, DATE_TRUNC('day', hour_utc)::DATE
ON CONFLICT (city, pollutant, day_utc)
DO UPDATE SET
  avg_value     = EXCLUDED.avg_value,
  max_value     = EXCLUDED.max_value,
  min_value     = EXCLUDED.min_value,
  samples_count = EXCLUDED.samples_count,
  sensors_count = EXCLUDED.sensors_count,
  computed_at   = NOW();
